description: Immigration requirements for the immigration tab (spec section 12). Numbers are not typed into the texts: a placeholder such as {gbp:IMM-WP-04.per_year} is filled from rules_2026.json, so every figure comes from a rule with an official source. Kinds: gbp, chf, n.

route.title: Global Business Mobility: Senior or Specialist Worker visa
route.summary: The employee needs a Senior or Specialist Worker visa, sponsored by the UK subsidiary once it holds a sponsor licence. A business visit before the move needs no visa, only an ETA, and the Swiss passport must be valid for the whole stay.

items.text: Senior or Specialist Worker visa: a certificate of sponsorship from a licensed UK sponsor, an eligible occupation, pay of at least {gbp:IMM-WP-01.min_salary} or the occupation's going rate if higher, and {n:IMM-WP-01.prior_service_months} months with the employer outside the UK unless paid {gbp:IMM-WP-01.prior_service_waived_from} or more.

Leave lasts for the certificate's period plus {n:IMM-WP-02.extra_days} days. The route allows up to {n:DUR-06.max_years} years in any {n:DUR-06.in_years}, or {n:DUR-06.max_years_high_pay} in any {n:DUR-06.in_years_high_pay} for pay of {gbp:DUR-06.high_pay_from} or more, and does not lead to settlement.

Apply online from outside the UK and prove identity with the app or at a visa application centre. Show {gbp:IMM-WP-03.maintenance} of savings unless the sponsor certifies maintenance. The fee is {gbp:DUR-04.fee_up_to} for up to {n:DUR-04.up_to_months} months and {gbp:DUR-04.fee_over} above.
items.time: About {n:IMM-WP-03.decision_weeks} weeks; a faster decision costs {gbp:IMM-WP-03.priority_fee} or {gbp:IMM-WP-03.super_priority_fee} more

items.text: Pay the Immigration Health Surcharge with the application: {gbp:IMM-WP-04.per_year} for each year of leave, and half of that for a remainder of {n:DUR-05.ihs_half_year_up_to_months} months or less.
Swiss citizens visit without a visa but need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA). It lasts {n:IMM-BV-01.valid_years} years or until the passport expires.

Allowed on a business visit: meetings, conferences, negotiating deals, site visits, and training or sharing knowledge on internal projects with UK colleagues. No paid or unpaid work, so the assignment itself needs the work visa.
A passport valid for the whole stay in the UK. Swiss identity cards are accepted only in some cases, such as EU Settlement Scheme status, so plan on the passport.
If it needs renewing: book an appointment at the Zurich passport office for fingerprints and a photo. An adult passport costs {chf:IMM-PP-02.fee} and is valid {n:IMM-PP-02.valid_years} years.
The UK subsidiary applies for a Worker sponsor licence: {gbp:IMM-SP-01.fee_large} for a medium or large sponsor, {gbp:IMM-SP-01.fee_small} for a small one. Not needed if it already holds one.
items.time: Most decisions within {n:IMM-SP-01.decision_weeks} weeks; a faster decision costs {gbp:IMM-SP-01.priority_fee} more

items.text: Assign a certificate of sponsorship. The employee must apply for the visa within {n:IMM-SP-02.use_within_months} months of it.

Pay the Immigration Skills Charge when assigning the certificate: {gbp:IMM-SP-03.large_first_12_months} for the first 12 months plus {gbp:IMM-SP-03.large_per_6_months} for each further 6 months ({gbp:IMM-SP-03.small_first_12_months} and {gbp:IMM-SP-03.small_per_6_months} for a small sponsor). The exemption for EU nationals on this route does not cover Swiss nationals.
Check the right to work before the first working day, online with the employee's share code, and keep a record.
Sponsor duties: keep records, monitor the employee's immigration status and attendance, and report changes to UKVI within {n:IMM-SP-04.report_within_working_days} working days.

timeline.step: UK subsidiary gets a sponsor licence
Employee checks the passport and renews it if needed
Employee gets an ETA for business visits before the move
Employer assigns the certificate of sponsorship and pays the skills charge
Employee applies for the visa and pays the health surcharge
Employer checks the right to work; the assignment can start
